description: This file defines the 'SaveHandler' interface, which serves as a super interface for all save-related handlers in the OpenMRS project. It declares a method for setting required data when saving OpenMRS objects, and includes metadata annotations and licensing information.

classes.name: SaveHandler
classes.description: A generic interface for handling save actions on OpenMRS objects that require setting required data before persistence.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets required data on the given OpenMRS object before saving, including creator, date, and optional additional data.
